subject: User cannot connect to VPN, error 809
description: Remote user reports the VPN client fails to connect from home with error 809. Was working last week.
resolution_notes: Error 809 is the VPN endpoint being unreachable behind NAT. Set registry key AssumeUDPEncapsulationContextOnSendRule = 2 under PolicyAgent, rebooted. VPN connected successfully.
technician_notes: Common after home router/firewall changes. Keep the reg fix in the KB.

subject: Remote access failing after Windows update
description: Since the latest Windows feature update the user can no longer establish a remote connection to the corporate network.
resolution_notes: Windows update reset the VPN adapter. Reinstalled the VPN client, re-imported the machine certificate, forced IKEv2. Connection restored.
technician_notes: Check the machine cert first whenever remote access breaks right after an update.

subject: Cannot reach internal systems from home office
description: User can sign in to the VPN but cannot open any internal websites or file shares once connected.
resolution_notes: Split-tunnel DNS was not resolving internal hosts. Flushed DNS, set the corporate DNS suffix on the VPN adapter. Internal resources reachable.
technician_notes: If tunnel connects but nothing resolves, it's almost always DNS.

subject: VPN drops every few minutes
description: The tunnel connects but disconnects repeatedly, roughly every 5 minutes, on a home Wi-Fi connection.
resolution_notes: Idle timeout plus unstable Wi-Fi. Disabled power management on the wireless adapter and raised the client keepalive. Stable since.
technician_notes: Wireless power saving is a frequent cause of dropped tunnels on laptops.

subject: New starter cannot log in to remote gateway
description: Newly onboarded employee is unable to authenticate to the remote access gateway on their first day.
resolution_notes: Account was not yet a member of the VPN-Users security group. Added to group, forced AD sync, user authenticated.
technician_notes: Onboarding checklist should include VPN-Users group membership.

subject: Outlook won't open, stuck on loading profile
description: Desktop Outlook hangs on the 'Loading Profile' splash and never opens the mailbox.
resolution_notes: Corrupt OST. Started Outlook in safe mode, disabled the misbehaving add-in, rebuilt the OST via a new profile. Mailbox opens normally.
technician_notes: 9 times out of 10 a stuck profile is a corrupt OST or a bad add-in.

subject: Not receiving emails since this morning
description: User's mailbox has stopped receiving new messages but can still send. No changes reported.
resolution_notes: An inbox rule created by mistake was moving all mail to a local folder. Disabled the rule, moved messages back. Delivery normal.
technician_notes: Always check inbox rules before escalating a 'not receiving mail' ticket.

subject: Mailbox is full and cannot send
description: User receives 'mailbox full' bounce-backs and is unable to send new messages.
resolution_notes: Mailbox over quota. Ran the mailbox cleanup, emptied deleted items, applied an archive policy. Send restored.
technician_notes: Recommend enabling online archive for heavy users.

subject: Shared mailbox not showing in Outlook
description: User was granted access to a shared mailbox but it does not appear in their Outlook.
resolution_notes: Automapping had not propagated. Manually added the shared mailbox as an additional account, confirmed permissions. Now visible.
technician_notes: Automapping can take a while; manual add is the quick fix.

subject: Meeting invites going to junk
description: Calendar invitations from external partners are landing in the junk email folder.
resolution_notes: Added the partner domains to the safe senders list and adjusted the junk filter level. Invites now arrive in the inbox.
technician_notes: Consider an org-level allow entry if multiple users report the same partner.

subject: Account locked out repeatedly
description: User's account keeps getting locked out several times a day even after a password reset.
resolution_notes: A phone still had the old password cached for the mailbox. Removed the stored credential on the mobile device and cleared cached creds on the laptop. No further lockouts.
technician_notes: Cached credentials on phones and mapped drives are the usual lockout culprit.

subject: Forgot password and cannot sign in
description: User cannot remember their password and is unable to sign in to their workstation.
resolution_notes: Verified identity per policy, reset the password, required change at next logon. User signed in successfully.
technician_notes: Always verify identity with the security questions before any reset.

subject: MFA not sending push notification
description: The authenticator app is not receiving the sign-in approval prompt, so the user cannot complete login.
resolution_notes: Push registration had broken after a phone reset. Re-registered the authenticator, tested a successful sign-in. Prompts arriving.
technician_notes: After any phone change the MFA method usually needs re-enrolling.

subject: New phone, need to set up authenticator
description: User replaced their mobile and needs help re-enrolling multi-factor authentication.
resolution_notes: Removed the old MFA device, sent a temporary access pass, user re-enrolled the authenticator on the new phone.
technician_notes: Temporary access pass is the cleanest way to re-onboard MFA.

subject: Printer offline and will not print
description: Office printer shows as offline on the user's PC and jobs sit in the queue without printing.
resolution_notes: Cleared the stuck print spooler, restarted the Print Spooler service, reconnected the printer by IP. Printing restored.
technician_notes: Restarting the spooler clears most 'offline' printer tickets.

subject: Cannot print to network printer after office move
description: After relocating desks the user can no longer send documents to the nearby printer.
resolution_notes: The new desk was on a different subnet. Mapped the correct printer for that floor via the print server. Test page printed.
technician_notes: Desk moves often need the printer for the new location re-mapped.

subject: Print jobs stuck in queue
description: Documents show as printing but never come out; the queue keeps growing.
resolution_notes: Corrupt job at the head of the queue. Cleared the queue folder, restarted the spooler, reprinted. Jobs completing.
technician_notes: One bad job can block the whole queue.

subject: Wi-Fi keeps dropping on laptop
description: User's laptop repeatedly loses the wireless connection in the office throughout the day.
resolution_notes: Outdated wireless driver plus adapter power saving. Updated the driver and disabled power management on the adapter. Stable connection since.
technician_notes: Driver update plus power-management fix resolves most flaky Wi-Fi.

subject: No internet connection on desktop
description: Wired desktop has no network connectivity; other machines on the same desk work fine.
resolution_notes: Faulty patch cable. Replaced the cable, confirmed link light and DHCP lease. Connectivity restored.
technician_notes: Swap the cable early - it's quick to rule out.

subject: Slow network and pages timing out
description: Websites load very slowly and frequently time out for a single user on the wired network.
resolution_notes: NIC had negotiated at 100Mbps half duplex. Forced full duplex / gigabit on the switch port, speeds normal.
technician_notes: Check duplex/speed negotiation on isolated slow-network reports.

subject: Laptop very slow and freezing
description: Machine takes a long time to start up and freezes during normal work.
resolution_notes: Disk at 100% from a stuck background update and low free space. Cleared temp files, freed disk, let updates finish. Performance normal.
technician_notes: Check disk usage and free space before imaging a 'slow laptop'.

subject: Laptop won't turn on
description: User reports the laptop is completely dead and shows no signs of power.
resolution_notes: Drained battery plus faulty charger. Supplied a replacement charger, performed a power drain / hard reset. Boots normally.
technician_notes: Try a known-good charger and a hard reset before booking hardware repair.

subject: External monitor not detected
description: Second monitor is not picked up when connected to the docking station.
resolution_notes: Dock firmware out of date. Updated the dock firmware and graphics driver, reseated the cable. Monitor detected.
technician_notes: Dock firmware is a common cause of missing external displays.

subject: Teams call has no audio
description: During Teams meetings the user cannot hear others and their microphone is not picked up.
resolution_notes: Wrong audio devices selected and missing mic permission. Set the correct default devices, granted Teams microphone access in Windows privacy settings. Audio working.
technician_notes: Check Windows privacy mic permissions for Teams audio issues.

subject: OneDrive not syncing files
description: Files saved locally are not appearing in OneDrive and the sync icon shows an error.
resolution_notes: Sync stuck on a file with an invalid character in the name plus a full local cache. Renamed the file, reset OneDrive, sync completed.
technician_notes: Invalid filename characters silently stall OneDrive sync.

subject: Cannot access SharePoint site
description: User gets an access denied message when opening a team SharePoint site they need for work.
resolution_notes: User was not in the site's members group. Site owner approved, added the user, access confirmed.
technician_notes: Route SharePoint access requests to the site owner for approval.

subject: Application crashes on launch
description: A line-of-business application closes immediately every time the user tries to open it.
resolution_notes: Corrupt local config after a failed update. Cleared the app's local cache/config folder, repaired the install. Launches normally.
technician_notes: Clearing the local config resolves most launch-crash tickets for this app.

subject: Need software installed for new role
description: User starting a new role requires a design application installed on their machine.
resolution_notes: Confirmed license availability, pushed the package via the software portal, verified it launches. Completed.
technician_notes: Check license count before deploying paid software.

subject: Excel keeps crashing when opening large files
description: Excel freezes and closes when the user opens large spreadsheets with many formulas.
resolution_notes: A COM add-in was conflicting and calc was set to automatic on a huge workbook. Disabled the add-in, set manual calc for that file. Stable.
technician_notes: Disable add-ins first when Office apps crash on specific files.

subject: Work phone cannot access company email
description: User's mobile device stopped syncing corporate email after a policy update.
resolution_notes: Device fell out of compliance in MDM. Re-enrolled the device, applied the mail profile, sync restored.
technician_notes: Compliance drift after policy changes blocks mobile mail; re-enroll fixes it.

subject: Cannot install company app on mobile
description: User is unable to install the required company application from the managed app catalog.
resolution_notes: Device was not enrolled in the management portal. Enrolled the device, the managed app catalog appeared, app installed.
technician_notes: Managed apps require enrollment first.

subject: New employee needs access to shared drive
description: A new team member cannot open the department shared drive required for their tasks.
resolution_notes: Added the user to the department file-share security group, ran a group policy update, mapped the drive. Access confirmed.
technician_notes: Shared-drive access is group-based; add to the right AD group.

subject: Request access to finance folder
description: User needs read access to a restricted finance folder for a monthly reporting task.
resolution_notes: Obtained approval from the data owner, granted read-only membership, verified access. Completed per least-privilege.
technician_notes: Restricted folders need data-owner approval before granting access.

subject: Screen resolution looks wrong after update
description: After a system update the display looks stretched and the resolution is incorrect.
resolution_notes: Graphics driver rolled back during the update. Reinstalled the correct display driver, set native resolution. Display correct.
technician_notes: Updates sometimes swap the GPU driver; reinstall the vendor driver.
